as_told.title: DOE NEST teams as Weygandt's recovery team

plain: A man named Jonathan Weygandt says that in Peru in 1997 he came upon a crashed craft, and that people from the Department of Energy were at the scene. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb thinks these were "highly likely" the Department of Energy's Nuclear Emergency Support Team, a unit trained to deal with nuclear and dangerous materials. If he is right, an existing hazard team would double as a crash-recovery team. He ties this to the 1954 Atomic Energy Act, a law on nuclear secrets, and in another conversation he links it to EG&G, a defence contractor, and to the Wilson-Davis memo, notes said to record a talk about hidden UFO programmes.
